official: 大田区乳幼児、義務教育就学児及び高校生等の医療費の助成に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会区長提出議案

name: 医療費助成で個人番号カードを使えるように
summary: 現在、医療費助成を受ける際は医療証を使います。この改正で、医療機関などで助成を受ける資格を確認できる場合は、医療証に加えて個人番号カードを提示する方法が加わります。令和8年4月1日に施行されます。
changes: 医療証に加え、医療機関などで助成資格を確認できる場合に個人番号カードを使えるようにする
被扶養者に関する規定を、疾病や負傷について医療給付を受ける人を示す表現に改める
who: 乳幼児、義務教育就学児、高校生等
医療費助成を受ける子どもの保護者
why: 医療費助成を受ける手続に個人番号カードを提示する方法を加え、規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Allows Individual Number Cards to be used for medical expense subsidies
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ota City Ordinance on Subsidies for Medical Expenses for Infants, Children of Compulsory Education Age, and High School Students, etc.
en.summary: Currently, people use a medical care certificate to receive medical expense subsidies. Under this amendment, when a medical institution, etc. can confirm eligibility for a subsidy, people may present an Individual Number Card in addition to the medical care certificate. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Allows people to use an Individual Number Card, in addition to a medical care certificate, when a medical institution, etc. can confirm their eligibility for the subsidy
Revises the provision concerning dependants to refer to people receiving medical benefits for illness or injury
who: Infants, children of compulsory education age, and high school students, etc.
Parents or guardians of children receiving medical expense subsidies
en.why: The ward says this is to add the option of presenting an Individual Number Card when applying for medical expense subsidies and to update the provisions.
